About the author and this guide

Cristian Trucco

Technology professional with experience leading development teams, software engineering and digital channels.

This material grew out of my studies in artificial intelligence, Agentic SDLC and software engineering. While preparing it, I used ChatGPT to support learning, research, organization and content structuring, supplementing my studies with technical documentation, articles and other publicly available sources.

My goal is to share knowledge freely and accessibly, connecting fundamentals, architectures, code examples and practical applications. The sources consulted should be identified in the guide's references.
